preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N > 0 and N <= 100 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer N between 1 and 100 inclusive, representing the number of friends.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(Ai.is_integer() and Ai >= 0 and Ai < i for i, Ai in enumerate([int(x) for x in line.split()], 1)) for line, N in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence A has length N, where each A[i] is an integer between 0 and i-1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.is_integer() and output_line >= 0 for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of steps.

postconditions.expression: all(min_steps == compute_min_steps(N, A) for min_steps, (N, A) in zip([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()], [(int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1].split()[0]), [int(x) for x in stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2].split()]) for i in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the minimal number of steps required to seat all friends according to the rules, where compute_min_steps(N, A) is the correct algorithmic solution.
